payload.name: Broaden Ideal-Preference Retrieval to Event and Plan Memories
payload.description: When a question asks what a person thinks the ideal version of something should look like, and preference-kind search returns only general preferences without the asked attributes, search event and plan memories for the subject's ongoing search/consideration before answering.
content: When a question asks about a person's ideal or preferred version of something (ideal X, perfect Y, dream Z), include search variants with project/search verbs like 'looking for', 'searching for', 'considering', 'wants', 'needs' alongside preference verbs.

Do not restrict retrieval to memory_kind=preference. Also search event and plan memories for the subject that may describe the ongoing search or considerations and list specific attributes (e.g., location, materials, features).

If the first pass returns only general preferences unrelated to the asked attributes, run one broader search without the memory_kind filter, combining the subject, the topic, and the attribute terms from the question; stop once the asked attributes are covered or no new distinct details appear.

solves: Questions about a person's ideal or preferred version of something (e.g., ideal studio, dream home, perfect setup) fail when retrieval restricts to preference-kind memories, because the specific desired attributes are often stored in event/project/plan memories describing an ongoing search or consideration. This Skill guides searching across memory kinds to recover those attribute details.
